summary: Explicit, consumer-advanced seconds or turn clocks; the SDK createDeadline helper borrows compatible clocks for pollable duration windows.
useWhen: A mechanic needs explicit seconds/turns; compose createDeadline for exact arm/cancel/remaining/due queries over an existing clock.
limitations: No automatic advancement, callbacks, recurring timers or catch-up. Turns use positive safe integers. Deadline durations must be positive; action cooldowns remain in mechanics/actions. The SDK helper accepts compatible clocks independently of this provider.
